items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: our original group composed of Lloyd Scott, Don Frye, Luther Watson, McKinney, and later on came Milt Senior

ctx.x: The members out of that six piece --

It originated in Springfield, Ohio -- McKinney's Cotton Pickers, because McKinney was a drummer in Springfield, and our original group composed of Lloyd Scott, Don Frye, Luther Watson, McKinney, and later on came Milt Senior, who was one of the first saxophonists in the State of Ohio -- and that was the beginning of the Cotton Pickers.
And all five out of the six went into the McKinney --
